pr_title: fix: get correct insert ids for multiple entities inserted
pr_comments: I've been wondering whether this method is reliable for MySQL/MariaDB. Quick research says "yes, but not always" - https://stackoverflow.com/a/8481692 . Perhaps it should be documented somewhere that correctness of this approach depends on `innodb_autoinc_lock_mode` config value?
@Talv Thank you for the information. I think so too but I have no idea where it should be documented. I'll create an issue for this.

issue_context.title: InsertResult return the same primary key
comments: Same happens when using mysql databases. Would be cool if "identifiers" and "generatedMaps" contain the correct ids for all inserted objects.

An option to not return the ids and avoid making a new select query for each inserted row would be ideal too 

If you insert 100 rows, it will make 100 select statements after the insert. Crazy stuff. It selects only the Id and the CreateDateColumn

Hi everyone, so any updates here? Is it because of driver or sth?
I checkout the log from `ReturningResultsEntityUpdator.js` and `identifiers` are already polluted before being pushing to `insertResult.identifiers` array.
Meet the same situation. Is there any updates or solutions?
updates anyone? this is the same with mysql
Any updates on this? It's really annoying bug...
I spent a lot of hours trying to find cause of my product's much higher level bug, but the root of the problems, as it turned out, is this bug :(
https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/6440 should make this error clearer - it'll throw an exception instead of just returning the wrong value
I created a PR #6668 to end this tragedy.

That only fixes the issue for MySQL when you're inserting multiple entities
  Unfortunately, that doesn't fix this issue which was opened for sqlite3.
@imnotjames My PR includes fix for sqlite. Please check this out. If there is anything I missed, could you advise on that?
Ah, you're right.  I missed that in the PR, apologies.
Still getting this same issue for sql.js and capacitor sqlite
